page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6v-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance belonging to the ecs.gn6v family. It is equipped with 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance features 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Graphics and parallel computing acceleration are delivered via a single NVIDIA Volta V100 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage and operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the CPU and memory subsystems operate primarily in the lower performance tiers. The single-core and multi-core CPU performance, measured via stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the bottom 25% and bottom 10% categories respectively, with a Geekbench single-core score of 604.0 and a multi-core score of 2324.0. Memory read bandwidth is also weak, recording 329.25 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 39.02 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. However, memory write bandwidth for large blocks shows average performance at 35.65 GB/sec. Other operations, including Redis SET at 5.66 million operations per second and static web serving throughput at 4.71 GB/sec, also rank in the bottom 25%.

The primary tradeoff of this instance lies in its hardware balance. While it offers dedicated GPU acceleration via the NVIDIA V100, the underlying Intel Xeon CPU and memory performance are weak relative to other cloud offerings. This makes the instance less cost-efficient for general-purpose or CPU-heavy tasks, but suitable for workloads that offload processing to the GPU. Appropriate workloads include GPU-accelerated machine learning model training, CUDA-based parallel processing, and ray tracing, provided they do not require high-speed local storage or high CPU single-core throughput.
